title: AMC 8 Explained: Format, Scoring and Test-Day Strategy
description:
Getting ready for the AMC 8? Here is everything kids and parents need to know: how the contest works, the one scoring rule most kids miss, and four test-day strategies.
We also try an AMC 8-style question together and share how to prepare.
